evals.name: read-notebook-url
evals.prompt: Аналізуй дані із цього Notebook і поєднай всі джерела в один суцільний документ: https://notebooklm.google.com/notebook/ae68f3e3-91d9-46b4-baff-4f300ed482ad
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Attempts web_fetch → 403. Cascades to React Artifact with Google OAuth UI or MCP tools. Does NOT stop to explain API limitation. Produces merged document template or Artifact UI.
assertions: Does NOT say 'NotebookLM has no API' and stop
Attempts web_fetch or MCP tool call before asking user
Either generates React Artifact OR calls notebooklm_* MCP tools
If manual needed: gives specific 1-2 step instruction, not open-ended question
Produces merged document structure if content obtained

evals.name: add-multiple-sources
evals.prompt: Додай ці джерела до мого NotebookLM: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning і https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neural_network і https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deep_learning
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Fetches all 3 URLs in parallel (not sequential). Prepares content packages. Provides step-by-step import instructions AND recommends appropriate generation features based on content type.
assertions: Fetches all URLs (parallel processing, not one-by-one with permission)
Provides clear import instructions for NotebookLM
Recommends at least one generation feature (Study Guide, Briefing Doc, etc.)
Does NOT ask 'which URL should I start with?'

evals.name: feature-generator-survey
evals.prompt: Згенеруй все що можливо з мого Notebook для підготовки до іспиту з машинного навчання
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Asks ALL survey questions in ONE message (goal/audience/time/outputs/language). Then autonomously builds generation plan with Study Guide, FAQ, Flashcards, Audio Overview. Provides exact UI click path for each feature.
assertions: Asks survey in one message, not sequential questions
Plan includes Study Guide and Flashcards for exam prep context
Provides exact NotebookLM UI steps per feature
Ends with 5 targeted Chat query suggestions

evals.name: mobile-friendly-instructions
evals.prompt: Привіт. Як мені подивитись що в моєму notebook? Я на телефоні
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Detects mobile context. Provides SHORT steps with emoji navigation. Does NOT suggest Ctrl+A or other desktop shortcuts. Offers React Artifact option that works on mobile.
assertions: Uses emoji for navigation (tap ⋮, etc.)
Short steps (not technical paragraphs)
No Ctrl+A, Cmd+C or other desktop shortcuts
Offers Artifact or mobile-friendly manual option

evals.name: deep-research-new-feature
evals.prompt: Запусти Deep Research в моєму Notebook про квантові обчислення
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Reads capabilities file. Identifies Deep Research as new Nov 2025 feature. Provides correct Studio navigation path. Explains agentic nature of this feature.
assertions: References Deep Research as agentic / new 2025 feature
Gives correct Studio navigation path
Explains that NotebookLM will search web beyond existing sources
Does NOT confuse with regular Chat query

evals.name: context-chat-export
evals.prompt: Перенеси нашу розмову про MCP сервери до мого NotebookLM як джерело
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers (MODE C: chat context). Structures conversation as annotated document. Provides ready-to-paste text. Gives copy instructions for Copied Text source type.
assertions: Structures chat context into formatted document
Includes key decisions/facts/next steps sections
Provides ready-for-paste content
Specifies 'Copied text' source type in instructions

version_note: evals authored at v3.0.0, revalidated against skill v4.2.3 on 2026-07-03
